document_text.description: This must contain the full extracted plain-text content of the uploaded document.  The agent should only call this tool AFTER the system has extracted text from the PDF or image.  This field must NEVER contain filenames or summaries - only the actual extracted text from the user-uploaded file.

file_name.description: Name of the file being audited (used for document_label in the report).

name: example-audit-Script-Tool
description: Analyzes the extracted text of a document against rules in the `audit_rules` table.
* `document_text` (string): The full text of the document.
* `findings` (string): A pre-formatted text block listing all missing or weak clauses.
* `remediation` (string): A pre-formatted text block listing recommended actions.
* `detailed_clauses` (array): A list of objects containing technical details for every rule checked.
Always provide the result to the agent.
